entries.description: The palette entries to change. Each carries `id` — the identifier elementor-global-tokens-get reports — and at least one of `color` and `title`. An `id` the palette does not hold refuses the WHOLE request and changes nothing.

color.description: The new colour, as hex (`#RGB`, `#RGBA`, `#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA`) or as `rgb()`/`rgba()`. The empty string clears the entry's colour. No other form is accepted.

title.description: A new display name for the entry. The identifier never changes with it.

tokenDigest.description: A digest over both colour repeater lists as stored, which is what verification compares.

entryCount.description: How many addressable palette entries the site holds. This operation never changes it.
